name: Kit start-up timing: on cold loads of the login page, #/home (three times) and a details deep link, every kit starts within 50 ms of window.ApiClient appearing and no request to a plugin route goes out before ApiClient.getCurrentUserId() is set. probes/kit-boot-probe.js records the moments; the kit's own timing is window.__jfkit[<prefix>].timing. The data is collected first and asserted at the end, so a run against a build without the kit (Bookmarks 1.0) still records the comparison values before it fails.

steps.name: sign in as admin (a cold load of the login page, then a sign-in without a reload)
find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: cold load of the details deep link
the Bookmarks section rendered after its API calls
every load: the kit saw window.ApiClient within 50 ms
steps.message: a kit start lag is missing or above 50 ms

steps.name: every load: no request to /Bookmarks before getCurrentUserId() was set
steps.message: a plugin API call went out without a signed-in user

steps.name: the kit's own record agrees: its first API call came after it saw the user
steps.assert: [__vars.login, __vars.home1, __vars.home2, __vars.home3, __vars.details].every(s => { const t = s.kits.jfbm.timing; return t.firstApi === null || (typeof t.user === 'number' && t.firstApi >= t.user); })

steps.name: the details load did call the plugin API (the check above is not vacuous)
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
